item.title: Show HN: Papiers.ai, a new workspace for reading and research
item.description:
Hey HN, I built http://papiers.ai, a new workspace for everything you read.

As AI gets better at writing, there will be far more worth reading, even in technical domains like scientific research.

Our time and attention won’t grow at the same rate, so software should help us make sense of more information while learning what matters to us from what we save, highlight, and share, and the questions we ask.

The Papiers desktop app and Chrome extension are a first step in that direction. Download today for Mac, Windows, or Ubuntu at http://papiers.ai!

Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49651351

Points: 1
